rows.text: when `rcx` is non-null and its signed word `+0x0` count is positive, scans the 0x20-byte entries of the array at qword `rcx+0x8` for one whose dword `+0x0` equals `edx`; on a match it loads that entry's qword `+0x8` and, when non-null, stores `r8d` to its dword `+0xE4`; a null `rcx`, a zero count, no match or a null entry pointer stores nothing

for each index from 0 while it is below the signed word `+0x0` of `rcx` (re-read every pass), loads qword `+0x8` of that 0x20-byte entry of the array at qword `rcx+0x8` and, when it is non-null, stores `edx` to its dword `+0xE4`; a count of 0 or less stores nothing

loads the qword at index `edx` (sign-extended) of the pointer array at qword `rcx+0x60` (a null `rcx` leaves a null pointer that is then dereferenced) and tests its byte `+0x8` AND 0x3C: when that is not 4 it returns this element pointer; when it is 4 it returns the qword at index `r8d` (sign-extended) of the array at qword `+0x60` of the element's qword `+0x18`, or 0 when that qword `+0x18` is null

scans the 33 (0x21) four-byte entries of the table at `00D233A0` for one whose word `+0x0` equals `ecx` and takes its word `+0x2` as an index (0 when none matches), then loads qword `+0x170` + index*8 of the object at qword `0209AC30`; when that pointer is non-null and bit 0x20 of its byte `+0x7C` is clear it tail-jumps (`00563FC0` + 0x46) with `rcx` = the pointer, otherwise it returns
